title: Сказка на ночь для Алиты
alt: Ночная сказка Алиты / A Bedtime Tale / Bedtime Tale Alita A Bedtime Tale 阿莉塔的睡前故事
description: The soul that looks to the dragon is born of dark shadows from longing; the light guides the young archer and helps him find the courage to fight the darkness. "...Everyone has a shadow in their heart." The grandma complains that she is running out of stories. (Source: Studio Tumble Youtube Channel, edited)

en:
The soul that looks to the dragon is born of dark shadows from longing; the light guides the young archer and helps him find the courage to fight the darkness.

"...Everyone has a shadow in their heart."

The grandma complains that she is running out of stories.



(Source: Studio Tumble Youtube Channel, edited)
